result.topic_en: Reduction of repeated instrument readings (index I) taken in different positions of a surveying/astronomical instrument, from which the constants p+a, b, c and the reading B are determined by taking means.

methods.what: Observation equations modelling instrument readings in the different positions in terms of the true reading B and the instrument errors p+a, b, c
methods.quote:
$h = B + p + a - b$
$v = B - p - a + b$
$V = B + p + a - b + 2c$
$h' = B - p - a - b$
$v' = B + p + a + b$

methods.what: Elimination giving two independent determinations of each unknown, then taking the arithmetic mean
methods.quote: Man bekommt also für $p+a$, $b$, $c$, $B$ doppelte Bestimmungen aus denen man das Mittel nehmen kann.

methods.what: Formulas for B as mean of paired readings
Determination of c from V and the other quantities
